title: Oracle Stock (ORCL) Falls 8.5% as AI Stocks Slide (Nov 20)
summary: Oracle (ORCL) fell 8.48% to $101.19 on Nov 20, 2026, as an AI stock sell-off hit the Nasdaq. What drove the move and what Oracle said on funding.
body_markdown:
Among AI-linked stocks,[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) dropped 14.01% and[CoreWeave (CRWV)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/crwv/) fell 12.02%, while[Microsoft (MSFT)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) declined 2.77%. After the session, Oracle stood 59.56% below its 52-week high and 0.94% above its 52-week low.


## Why Oracle Stock Fell


No fetched source named an Oracle-specific cause for Friday's decline; the stock fell with a market-wide retreat from AI shares. According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/20/sp-500-correction-market-sell-off.html) , the week's[initial public offering of Anthropic](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-prices-83-raises-81-billion/) became "the ultimate 'sell the news' moment for the AI trade," and the Nasdaq had its worst week since March 2020.


CNBC also reported that selling in Nvidia intensified on Friday after a Reuters headline said the chipmaker's accounting is the focus of a Securities and Exchange Commission probe. The outlet listed that pressure, along with[Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia's CEO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-20-2026/) , among the forces behind the sell-off.


Separately, Oracle said on Friday that its infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded following a final capital raise earlier in November, as reported by[Startup Fortune](https://startupfortune.com/oracle-says-its-300-billion-openai-buildout-is-fully-funded-after-a-20-billion-raise/) , which cited Reuters. "The financing we outlined at Oracle Investor Day, including vendor financing, is in place," the company said, according to the report. Startup Fortune reported that the shares rose in after-hours trading after the statement, outside the regular session covered here.


## ORCL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Oracle says the OpenAI contract is fully funded after a raise of about $20 billion completed earlier in November, per Startup Fortune.
- In Oracle's fiscal first quarter, cloud infrastructure revenue rose 121% to $7.39 billion and remaining performance obligations reached $664 billion,[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/billionaire-david-tepper-appaloosa-opened-175908841.html) reported.
- A 13F filed on November 16 showed David Tepper's Appaloosa opened a position of 1,253,932 Oracle shares worth about $172 million as of September 30, according to 24/7 Wall St., which noted the stock has fallen sharply since then.


### Risks


- Quarterly capital spending of $28.5 billion left Oracle's[free cash flow](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/free-cash-flow-and-net-cash-flow-explained-2/) at negative $5.4 billion, per 24/7 Wall St., which said the bear case centers on negative free cash flow, rising debt and reliance on a small group of large AI customers.
- The November raise included about $10 billion of stock, which Startup Fortune said means existing shareholders have been diluted.
- CNBC listed fears of stricter rules on building data centers, after Democrats won Congress, among the pressures on the AI trade, a concern that touches Oracle's data center buildout.
